title: DEFICIT
description: Late-night bus-stop surrealism: while waiting for the last bus of the night, an eccentric, socially awkward server tries to make conversation with the mysterious suited man beside him — and things get increasingly bizarre in this deadpan surreal comedy, set to a custom-composed score performed by real session musicians. Written, directed, and starring Jacob Willett on a budget under $200, with Gabe Zendejas behind the camera as DP, editor, and colorist. DEFICIT and its companion short, Hang-Ups, are the two student films that got Jacob into SDSU's film production program.
